19.title: [1.15 Hotfix] Overall coordination — parent of #20–#25
19.body:
## Current coordination — 2026-11-11

**Overall parent tracker. Open / In progress.** At the maintainer's request, Codex is reconciling this tracker with #24. This issue coordinates the whole hotfix; it does not duplicate the implementation owned by each workstream.

| Issue | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| **#19 — this issue** | Overall scope, priorities, dependency/status summary and final hotfix closure |
| **#24** | Technical map/state, starting-country and DLC compatibility; journal implementation remains delegated to #39 |
| **#25** | Cross-system regression, reviewed integration and release preparation |

### Direct workstreams — live GitHub issue states checked 2026-11-11
- [x] #20 — startup baseline and initial diagnostics: closed as completed.
- [x] #21 — obsolete script APIs: closed as completed.
- [x] #22 — diplomacy and war-goal compatibility: closed as completed.
- [x] #23 — economy, goods and production methods: closed as completed.
- [ ] #24 — map/startup/DLC workstream: still open; current residual findings and dependencies live there.
- [ ] #25 — integrated regression/integration/release gate: still open.

Recent follow-ups **#48–#53 are also closed on GitHub**. Their old body text can still mention pending review; this list records the live issue state without inventing a separate engine test, test date or release acceptance. Existing explicit maintainer acceptances remain valid and are not requested again.

### What is still actionable here
- Follow #24's remaining technical findings and #39's catalogue acceptance; do not repeat those audits as a second #19 implementation.
- Follow #25's integration and current-candidate regression results. Earlier authorized history integration is already recorded there; this edit authorizes no new Git operation.
- Keep the remaining known issues and any release decision in one place. Close #19 only after the #25 gate and applicable blocking workstream gates are satisfied.
- Historical boundary arbitration remains with #18; the independent starting-law audit remains #17. Deferred #38 does not become a new urgent task through this tracker.

The maintainer requested taking #19 and #24 because their earlier descriptions looked alike. They remain separate **parent and technical workstream**, with no issue closed as a duplicate, no task removed to manufacture completion, and no #39/#25 ownership change.

Evidence: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE19_24_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION_2026_11_11/`.
This pass changes issue titles/descriptions and writes read-only audit evidence only; no gameplay, native, Git or publication change. **No Project Status field or actual parent relation is edited/verified through the current tools.**

<details>
<summary>Original coordination scope and release rules — retained as dated history</summary>

## Victoria 3 Update 1.15 — Hotfix coordination

**Game update:** Victoria 3 1.15 `Ivan-Chai/Fireweed` (released 2026-11-05)
**DLC:** State and Revolution
**Owner:** @Malzars-sys
**Scope:** Restore compatibility and gameplay stability before adding optional 1.15 features.

### Workstreams
- [ ] #20 — Clean baseline, fresh-game launch and error-log triage (**P0 — start here**)
- [ ] #21 — Deprecated script keys, triggers and effects migration (**P0**)
- [ ] #22 — War support, war goals and diplomacy regression tests (**P0 if broken**)
- [ ] #23 — Goods, copper, production methods, buildings and trade (**P1 / P0 if blocking**)
- [ ] #24 — Map/state definitions, journal entries, and DLC compatibility (**P0 if blocking**)
- [ ] #25 — Integrated regression testing and release readiness (**P0 before release**)

### Non-negotiable rules
1. Start with **#20**, compare vanilla 1.15 and the mod on **new games**, and record exact installed build/DLC configuration.
2. Do not assume all failures generate `error.log` entries: parser triage and gameplay tests are separate requirements.
3. Make targeted fixes on a dedicated hotfix branch/PR; preserve ongoing map work (#18) and @Yekatarina's independent law audit (#17).
4. Do not unilaterally alter the historical 1776 scenario or add advanced technologies just to suppress errors.
5. Existing saves from pre-1.15 versions are not a meaningful compatibility test for this release.
6. Close this coordination issue only after #25 acceptance criteria are met, with known issues and test evidence documented.

### Reference materials
- [Official 1.15 release notes / Steam announcement](https://steamcommunity.com/app/529340/announcements)
- [Victoria 3 modding digests](https://github.com/Victoria-3-Modding-Co-op/Modding-Digests)

**Suggested Project status:** In progress.
**Suggested Project priority:** P0.

24.body:
## Current technical workstream — 2026-11-11

**Open / In progress. Parent coordination: #19.** At the maintainer's request, Codex is reconciling #24 and #19. This issue owns technical map/startup/DLC compatibility; overall hotfix prioritization and closure belong to #19, and integrated release validation belongs to #25.

The journal catalogue remains part of this workstream's acceptance scope, with implementation and its detailed checks delegated to **#39**. That work is not reassigned, removed or restarted by this pass.

### Current source qualification — read-only, 2026-11-11
A fresh run of `issue24_residual_scope_audit.py --self-test` reports:
- **13 provinces with conflicting unconditional ownership instructions**, retained for targeted interpretation; no engine winner or historical owner inferred.
- **One passable province without an initial allocation**: `xEF50C0`, Western Micronesia.
- **646 consistent capital selections** in the direct-instruction model: 642 defaults and four explicit history overrides.
- No parse error in the inspected inputs; **8/8 classification controls** pass.
- Status remains **QUALIFIED_STATIC_ONLY**, not global map, engine or historical acceptance.

These are current copies of previously known findings, not thirteen newly reproduced engine failures. The installed strategic-membership, Mindanao-port, capital/naming and same-owner duplicate fixes below are preserved.

### Work already separately closed on GitHub

- [x] #53 — supply-tutorial migration and eight journal tooltip keys.

These checkmarks reflect live closed issue states; stale pending-review prose in those issues is not treated as a new or detailed runtime receipt.

### Remaining work and boundaries
- [ ] Qualify the 13 contradictory ownership instructions and the Western Micronesia allocation against the relevant existing #18 evidence, separating a technical conflict from a historical decision. No arbitrary sovereign reassignment is authorized by this coordination edit.
- [ ] Complete #39's full journal/DLC acceptance without repeating the accepted bounded batches.
- [ ] Consolidate the map/startup, dynamic-name and feasible DLC-on/off checks for the actual current candidate. Retain any already supplied bounded maintainer acceptance; do not require optional save/date metadata or invent unreported tests.
- [ ] Hand the bounded result and remaining known issues to #25 for integrated release validation.

#24 can close when its original compatibility acceptance criteria are met, including its delegated journal scope; #19 stays open for the broader hotfix. The existing criteria are preserved below and are not reduced by this clarification.

Evidence and current input hashes: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE19_24_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION_2026_11_11/`.
No gameplay, population, border, law/technology, native, Git or publication change in this pass. **Titles and issue descriptions are updated; Project Status fields and actual parent relations are not edited/verified by the current tools.**

<details>
<summary>Earlier installations, evidence, original scope and acceptance criteria — retained</summary>

## Residual startup-reference delivery — Hawk, 2026-11-09

**Four bounded technical fixes: IMPLEMENTED_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION. Parent #24 remains open / In progress for outstanding content, map and engine gates.**

Installed locally against canonical 1.15.0:
- GR7's default capital: Blue Nile → Greenland, its sole initially owned state. Inuit culture and decentralized type unchanged.
- DIO's existing initial history gains only `set_capital = STATE_SENEGAL`, its sole initially owned state, overriding inherited Sierra Leone. No law/technology/centralization change.
- Removed the second occurrence of Yukon province `x26A0BA` in the same ATB ownership list. Its surviving owner/state pair is unchanged.
- Added a current-native same-path mask of `00_dynamic_state_names_europe.txt`, changing only `s:STATE_LITHUANIA` to `s:STATE_KAUNAS` in the Baltic naming dispatcher. The regions have the same id 153 and the same 23 provinces. All 141 native effect definitions otherwise retain their bytes; culture conditions, labels, hub names and game-rule paths remain native. Recompare this mask on future game updates.

**Executed checks:** 18/18 targeted checks and 8/8 classification cases. Every province's owner/state SET is unchanged; raw allocation tokens 41,085→41,084, distinct allocated provinces 41,071 unchanged. Population sources unchanged, delta 0. 2,519 existing inputs protected; only three approved existing runtime files changed, with one new native-mask file and one new read-only qualifier. No unexpected drift, Git/vanilla write or agent engine run.

The original 24 auditor remains unchanged. Its three original capital candidates are explained/corrected: PLC already has a valid Greater Poland history override; the two corrections above make the selected direct-instruction model coherent for all 646 initially holding countries (642 defaults, four explicit overrides). Helper/dynamic effects and actual decentralized-capital loading remain runtime questions.

**Visible remaining findings:** 13 contradictory unconditional ownership instructions (Kenya 2, Tanganyika 3, Mauritania 6, Eastern Himalayas 2) and unallocated `xEF50C0` in Western Micronesia. None is suppressed or assigned an invented historical owner. The engine winner and historical boundary decisions remain under #18/#24. Overall map audit still reports FINDINGS_STATIC_ONLY, not global compatibility.

Local evidence: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE24_RESIDUAL_SCOPES_2026_11_09/` — report, grouped engine protocol, before/after map audits and qualification, exact installation contract/candidates, targeted validation and source protection. Read-only qualifier: `tools/compatibility/issue24_residual_scope_audit.py`.

Next: grouped fresh-1776 capital/naming/save-reload check; separate historical qualification of the remaining ownership candidates. Accepted #22/#32/#40/#41 and the new #23 economy settings, #25 AI, #39 journals and WORLD/SERG work are preserved. No new human acceptance or release approval is claimed.

---

## Current bounded follow-up — Hawk, 2026-11-09

**In progress — residual startup/map-reference qualification**, selected at the maintainer's request for a new mission after the grouped review and economy follow-up.

Scope: reproduce the 14 repeated province-allocation candidates, three capital candidates, unallocated Western Micronesia candidate and inherited dynamic-state-name reference. Trace exact source blocks and guards. Distinguish same-owner repetition, conditional alternatives, history capital overrides, missing optional references and actual conflicts before making a correction.

Any installed fix must be a demonstrated technical correction preserving sovereignty, border geometry, population and approved scenario. No arbitrary owner/capital choice or reactivation of deferred Spanish content. Historical border decisions remain under #18; #17, #21, #23's new economy settings, #25 AI and #39 journal work remain preserved. No Git writes, vanilla edits or runtime/human acceptance is authorized by this claim.

Local evidence: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE24_RESIDUAL_SCOPES_2026_11_09/`. This bounded delivery will not close parent #24 or declare overall release readiness.

---

## Optional-history qualification — #41, 2026-11-09

The four previously retained absent inherited country-history targets have been qualified under **#41**. Their direct `?=` blocks are optional and remain in the runtime files; the auditor now records their absence separately rather than presenting it as a mandatory missing provider. No country, initial owner, law or technology was added.

**21/21 checks, 13/13 regression cases, four required-operator controls; 2,956 existing runtime files unchanged.** The same 14 ownership candidates and all other map-audit payloads are retained. This is a tooling/diagnostic qualification, not a reproduced engine correction or acceptance of #24. Evidence: `V1_15_ISSUE41_DORMANT_HISTORY_2026_11_09/`.

Hawk's current #25 AI diagnostic pass, journals #39 and cultures #40 remain outside this task. Earlier snapshots below are preserved as dated history.

---

## Verified structural delivery — Codex, 2026-11-09

**Bounded map/state fixes: IMPLEMENTED_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION. Resumption after the disconnect is complete. #24 remains In progress for its overall dependencies and runtime acceptance.**

- Recovered both completed scans and verified the installed files: **31/31 candidate checks, 6/6 fixture controls and 24/24 final delivery checks pass**.
- Corrected five obsolete strategic-region references, restored membership for four existing mod states, and repaired Mindanao's one port-province field. Only three gameplay paths are written by this lot: two targeted strategic-region masks and `map_data/state_regions/12_indonesia.txt`.
- All four added memberships have unanimous native province-region provenance: Tartaria 46/46 -> Russia; Galich 282/282 -> Russia; Kaunas 23/23 -> Eastern Europe; Chukotka 474/474 -> Northeast Asia. No province, border, sovereignty, population, resource (including mod copper), law, climate or locator rewrite.
- Effective inventory: **783 state regions / 677 land states, 142 strategic regions, 1,074 country definitions**. The 1,378-provider final slice parses without error and the corrected structural findings are gone.
- The final preservation guard caught a concurrent edit to the five-year-plan event. The original **FAIL** is retained. A separate bounded dependency reconciliation checks the current event's parse/literal-reference slice; it does not review or accept #39's gameplay outcomes. The updated provider set/hashes and local Git index pass the final checks. **167 changed journal files and the concurrent additions are preserved.**
- **No engine test, vanilla edit, local Git write or publication** in this mission. The overall audits remain FINDINGS_STATIC_ONLY for the explicitly retained debt; no blanket compatibility PASS is claimed.

### Remaining findings and tracking

Created **#40**, now in **Project Backlog** and attached as an actual child of #24, for the removed `siberian` / `north_caucasian` cultures: 22 country/homeland references and **72 authored population records totaling 742,276 persons**. This is a sum of authored values, not measured runtime population loss. No demographic redistribution was performed; the native 1836 proportions must not be imported into 1776 automatically.

Four inherited dormant-country scopes, 14 multiply-authored ownership candidates, one unallocated province candidate, capital candidates and deferred dynamic-name/Spanish consumers are individually retained in `REMAINING_FINDINGS.json`. PLC's capital candidate is explained by its existing history override. Historical sovereignty arbitration belongs to #18; Spanish content remains deferred. #39 is excluded and its ownership/scripts/tracking are untouched.

Local deliverables (not committed/published):
`docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE24_MAP_DLC_2026_11_09/` — `REPORT.md`, `RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md`, `NEXT_ACTION.md`, final validation/source protection, before/candidate/native snapshots, explicit failed-guard/event reconciliation, and full findings.

Read-only auditor: `tools/compatibility/issue24_map_dlc_audit.py`. Runtime protocol: fresh 1776 game, four strategic memberships, Mindanao port/access, several simulated months, save/reload and DLC-on/off where feasible. The maintainer's existing acceptances are preserved; none of these new runtime paths is claimed accepted.

---

## Local implementation checkpoint — Codex, 2026-11-09

**In progress — three local compatibility corrections installed; final post-install validation interrupted by loss of the local execution environment. No engine acceptance or completion claim.**

### Confirmed before the disconnect

- Completed an effective-provider/map inventory and a separate canonical native control on installed **Victoria 3 1.15.0**. The mod inventory contains **783 state regions, including 677 land states; 142 strategic regions; 1,074 country definitions**. The native control has 782 regions / 676 land states. These are static inventory counts.
- Repaired **five obsolete native state references** and assigned the **four existing mod states** missing strategic-region membership. Province overlap establishes a single canonical strategic region for every province of each added member:
  - `STATE_TARTARIA` -> `region_russia`: 46/46 provinces.
  - `STATE_GALICH` -> `region_russia`: 282/282 provinces.
  - `STATE_KAUNAS` -> `region_eastern_europe`: 23/23 provinces.
  - `STATE_CHUKOTKA` -> `region_northeast_asia`: 474/474 provinces.
- The absent native Tula and Kostroma state references are removed from the strategic list; their provinces are already represented by existing mod states in the same strategic region. No state/province is created, transferred or renamed.
- Corrected **only Mindanao's port province** from the Molucca sea province `x16C9FB` to the existing land-port province `xF0014A`. Retained naval exit 3125 (Molucca Sea), ownership, locators and every other byte of the shared state-region file. This is a **pre-existing structural issue** introduced in commit `f34a6b88d` on 2026-10-14, not newly attributed to 1.15.
- **31/31 candidate checks passed before installation**, including preservation of all other strategic-region fields/objects and the exact one-field port edit. Installation then verified each installed file against its candidate hash.
- Installed paths: two new, intentionally scoped same-path strategic-region files (`common/strategic_regions/europe_strategic_regions.txt`, `common/strategic_regions/east_asia_strategic_regions.txt`) and the one-field edit in `map_data/state_regions/12_indonesia.txt`. The two region files preserve the remaining current canonical definitions; their future vanilla changes will require recomparison.
- Captured hashes of **2,125 local gameplay/map sources** before the pass. No journal, law, sovereignty, population, resource, bitmap or canonical vanilla edit; no Git operation or publication in this mission.

### Findings retained for semantic review

The initial scan also found **22 literal country/homeland references to removed `siberian` / `north_caucasian` culture IDs**, four inherited country-history scopes without a matching mod country definition, and a Mindanao hub defect described above. Population files also use the old cultures; exact demographic impact has not yet been evaluated. Do not invent culture replacements, restore 1836 countries or redistribute population to silence the scan.

Fourteen multiply-authored province-allocation candidates, one unallocated passable-province candidate and three capital candidates need conditional/history review. The native control itself lists 59 multiply-authored allocations, so these counts must **not** be represented as simultaneous ownership bugs or reproduced engine failures. No sovereignty arbitration was performed.

Canonical DLC metadata identifies State and Revolution as `dlc019 / ip5_content`. The non-journal gate inventory is static only; DLC-on/off reachability and runtime remain untested. Native 1836 Russia/Poland initialization was not copied into the 1776 scenario.

### Interruption and exact next action

The final post-install/native contextual scans were launched, but the local environment disconnected before their results could be retrieved. Their completion is **unknown**. The planned six fixture controls and final source/index guard have **no confirmed result**. Do not promote the 31 pre-install candidate checks to final validation.

When local access returns, first inspect existing `POST_INSTALL_AUDIT.json` and `NATIVE_CONTROL_CONTEXTUAL.json` and any still-running read-only audits. Preserve any completed results, check source/index hashes against the baseline and the three installed paths, then finish the fixtures, literal/population dependency analysis and bounded runtime protocol. Use new output filenames if a result already exists.

Local evidence: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE24_MAP_DLC_2026_11_09/` — initial mod/native audits, `BASELINE.json`, `REGION_PROVENANCE.json`, `INSTALLATION_PLAN.json`, `CANDIDATE_VALIDATION.json`, `CHANGES.patch`, candidate/before/native snapshots and `INSTALLATION_RECEIPT.json`. Read-only auditor: `tools/compatibility/issue24_map_dlc_audit.py` (its final expanded revision still needs the interrupted checks).

**#24 remains In progress. #39 is explicitly excluded and untouched; Hawk retains its journal work.** Historical map/law ownership and previous accepted witnesses remain preserved. No new runtime acceptance is claimed.

---

## Current bounded pass — Codex, 2026-11-09

**Project status: In progress. Selected by the maintainer as the next mission, explicitly excluding #39.**

Scope of this pass: structural compatibility of map/state and starting-country providers with canonical Victoria 3 1.15, plus non-journal DLC dependencies. Start with reproducible inventory and native/mod reference comparisons; install only demonstrated, bounded compatibility fixes when they do not conflict with concurrent work.

Preserve Hawk's #39 journal catalogue and all journal files; the historical map overhaul #18, Yekatarina's law audit #17, accepted northern-passability fixes and other local changes are outside this pass. No historical border/resource redistribution or starting-law rewrite is authorized by this claim. Canonical vanilla is read-only. No Git write, branch switch, merge or release publication is part of this new mission.

Deliverable: static findings with effective provider/source resolution, concrete dependency failures and bounded corrections if justified, plus an explicit engine/DLC-on/off validation protocol. Static checks will not be presented as runtime acceptance.

---

## Goal
Identify compatibility problems caused by 1.15's map/state, journal-entry and Russia-focused DLC changes, without restarting the historical map redesign.

## Checklist
- [ ] Compare vanilla 1.15 state regions, definitions, map-related resource files and the mod's overrides for structural conflicts.
- [ ] Validate map loading, ownership, state regions, starting countries and the initial 1776 setup in a fresh game.
- [ ] Check custom journal entries/events for altered outcomes, conditions, interfaces, scopes and missing localization.
- [ ] Test key Russia-related historical setups with **State and Revolution enabled**, and distinguish mandatory 1.15 fixes from optional DLC adaptation.
- [ ] Record DLC-on vs DLC-off differences **where feasible**; avoid making a paid DLC a mandatory dependency unless intentionally decided.
- [ ] Escalate any map/data changes that would conflict with the independent map overhaul issue #18.

## Acceptance criteria
All discovered blocking map/startup conflicts and journal failures documented, with targeted fixes or linked follow-up tasks; no unapproved historical rework.

Suggested Project status: **Backlog**. Suggested priority: **P0** for startup/map incompatibility, otherwise **P1**.

Parent tracking issue: #19.

Scope: **Victoria 3 1.15 / State and Revolution compatibility only.** Do not mix with the ongoing historical map overhaul (#18) or Yekatarina's separate historical law audit (#17). No blanket edits or ahistorical data changes without evidence. Reference the exact game build, file paths, and test results.

</details>

25.body:
## Current AI-context delivery — Hawk, 2026-11-09

**Bounded batch: IMPLEMENTED_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION. Parent #25 remains open / In progress for integrated release validation. No new engine or human acceptance is claimed.**

Installed locally against canonical Victoria 3 **1.15.0**:

- Corrected exactly two values in the existing default AI strategy: removed `building_naval_base` at level 15 becomes native `building_naval_administration` at level 3. The entire enclosing befriend branch now matches the native rule; every other byte of that shared file is preserved.
- Added five isolated files restoring six masked native objects: consolidation and confrontation agendas, revolutionary guard law, social-revolution journal, its reward event, and the white / anti-communist movement required by those agendas.
- The new journal uses a separate reward-event ID, `aor1776_v115_ai_progression.1`, with the native reward, duration and cleanup. Existing `communism.6` and the older communist journal remain unchanged. No starting law, granted starting technology, country, border, population, building recipe or automatic old-to-new journal handoff is changed.
- Verified inherited FR/EN localization, icons, prerequisite technology and typed dependencies. This is bounded provider restoration, not a claim of complete DLC progression parity.

### Executed evidence

- Two-value rule: **12/12 static checks**, **7/7 negative controls**.
- Restored dependencies: **213/213 static checks**, **8/8 negative controls**, on the installed files.
- Existing journal dependency auditor: **494 effective journal entries, zero typed-reference / metadata findings**; prior #39 entries preserved.
- Final selected AI references resolve; all **677 land-state regions** have one strategic membership in the current source model.
- Source protection: **5,909 pre-existing files**, only the two approved changes in one existing runtime file, plus the five new runtime files. Existing communist events, #22/#23/#24/#39/#40, WORLD/SERG sources and evidence preserved. Local HEAD and Git index unchanged; no Git writes, vanilla edits or publication.

### Remaining engine question

The retained six error logs contain **14,047 messages**, including **4,143 AI-related messages**; **4,127** are invalid `region` links. These are historical messages, not new post-fix observations or distinct bugs. The API is also used by native code and was not blindly rewritten. #24 has repaired four missing strategic memberships; that is a plausible explanation, **not proven engine causality or proof that the warnings disappeared**. A fresh 1776 run, simulation, save/reload and newly captured logs are required. Advanced revolutionary cases have separate checks in the protocol; unexercised cases stay unvalidated.

Local, uncommitted evidence:
`docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE25_AI_SCOPE_TRIAGE_2026_11_09/`
— `REPORT.md`, `RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md`, `DELIVERY_RECEIPT.json`, contracts, before/candidate snapshots, live validation, preserved initial failures and final source-protection receipt.

Next action: run the grouped protocol on the exact current local candidate. This batch does not close #25/#19 or satisfy the remaining global release gates.

<details>
<summary>Initial bounded assignment — retained</summary>

## Current bounded follow-up — Hawk, 2026-11-09

**Claimed at the maintainer's request: “Prends une autre mission.” #25 remains open; this pass concerns the remaining AI-context diagnostics, not release approval.**

- Scope: qualify the retained invalid strategic-region / AI scope diagnostics against the current effective providers and canonical 1.15.0. Separate obsolete logs from still-present source defects before proposing any correction.
- First step: read the exact captured messages and their call chains, compare the current native/mod scripts, and document a reproducible bounded finding. Old message counts are evidence to investigate, not proof of the current failure or a new crash.
- Preserve the #22 delivery, #23 economy work, #24 structural fixes, #39 journals, #40 cultures, the historical map and all human receipts. Do not reopen #21 or take #17 / the deferred #38.
- Any demonstrated fix must be limited to the current affected blocks, preserve concurrent edits and ship with source hashes, static checks and an engine protocol. No gameplay change or new validation is claimed by this assignment.
- No Git write, commit/push, checkout, merge, vanilla edit, release publication or broader integration action is authorized by this new pass. Earlier integration authorization stays limited to its recorded completed operation.
- Local ownership record: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE25_AI_SCOPE_TRIAGE_2026_11_09/CLAIM.md`.


</details>

---

## History integration completed — 2026-11-09

**Integration gate completed with the maintainer's explicit approval: “Oui, j'autorise.” #25 remains In progress for release validation.**

Published merge commit [8722a8a32eb08d63b8c55a6edf530b50ed817b68](https://github.com/Malzars-sys/1776-Age-of-Revolutions/commit/8722a8a32eb08d63b8c55a6edf530b50ed817b68) to `main` with a non-forced, expected-head update.

- First parent: `0396b1133168c1721b61cee5ae5334f1a4f5e4e1`.
- Second parent: `b72dc3584e1225f8c675b7c6c9f295cde122b821` (hotfix/1.15).
- Result tree: `ae449f27b1055c18b9581ee9a4deeb42be4030a2`, exactly the previous main tree.
- Remote readback confirms **zero changed files against previous main**, the hotfix head is now an ancestor of main, and **PR #34 is closed / merged=true** at this commit.
- Both heads and the proposed commit's exact parents/tree were rechecked before publication. No force push, local staging/checkout/merge, local gameplay write, vanilla edit or release publication occurred. All local uncommitted work remains outside this history-only merge.

The branch-divergence gate is resolved. This does **not** publish the uncommitted local launcher edits or the other local fixes, and does not add runtime acceptance. Remaining journal/diagnostic work and final exact-candidate engine checks are still tracked below; #19/#25 stay open.

Publication evidence: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE25_INTEGRATION_2026_11_09/PUBLISHED_MERGE_2026_11_09/`. Earlier preparation reports remain as historical records.

---

## Integration milestone — 2026-11-09

**In progress. Content reconciliation is prepared; branch history and release acceptance remain pending.**

- Reviewed all **62 PR #34 paths** against common ancestor, pinned remote hotfix, committed main and current workspace. All remote blobs match the PR object IDs. **Zero unresolved content decisions** remain in this bounded review.
- The committed integration candidate has **zero file changes against current main**: first parent `0396b1133168c1721b61cee5ae5334f1a4f5e4e1`, second parent `b72dc3584e1225f8c675b7c6c9f295cde122b821`, resulting tree `ae449f27b1055c18b9581ee9a4deeb42be4030a2`. Both remote heads were rechecked. This is an exact, reviewable history-only merge proposal, **not an executed merge**.
- Three explicit resolutions preserve main: native copper inheritance (base price **40**, superseded remote definition **50**), all **17 ordered Ottoman outcomes** plus newer display/progress fixes, and the journal validator's additional American-independence coverage. The apparent merchantman conflict is already represented in main; the newer local ship overhaul is excluded from the committed candidate.
- **16/16 static preparation checks pass**, including rejection of a stale resolution and a deliberately conflicting merge. Every proposed workspace file remains byte-identical to the captured workspace; committed candidates remain byte-identical to main. Git index unchanged. No gameplay or vanilla file was written.

## Current implementation — Hawk, 2026-11-09

**IMPLEMENTED_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION.** Installed locally; the issue remains open / In progress pending the full review and engine acceptance. No runtime result or complete DLC-parity acceptance is claimed.

### Installed
- Migrated **400 journal entries in 166 files** to **856 explicit outcomes** using per-entry parsed mappings, not a blanket regex conversion. All **1,381** original direct legacy conclusion fields are gone.
- Predicates, effect bodies/scopes, delays (including seven computed deadlines), progress, activation/disabled guards, callbacks and original predicate order are preserved. Custom headers and event/effect previews are moved into the appropriate outcomes.
- Restored exact native definitions `je_five_year_plan`, `je_meiji_imperial_marriage`, `je_state_and_revolution`, plus native `communism.12/.13` required by the plan's bound button and continuation. No new automatic activation/history wiring, ID alias or replacement of authored communist choices.
- Added missing names/reasons for 16 retained IDs in French and English: **32 keys per language**, without overwriting existing keys.
- Removed four unresolved Niger/Ethiopia button references from the old colonial hub; retained its eight other buttons. No new colonial action, country, geography or law change.

**Delivered footprint: 167 existing files changed + 4 new files, 171 files total.** Initial installation used nine independently verified batches of at most twenty mapping files. R1/R2/R3 evidence is retained; final installed hashes are in **MIGRATION_R4/INSTALLATION.json**.

### Fresh verification
- **11,117/11,117** mapping/preservation checks pass; **14/14** deliberate regressions detected by the expected semantic checks.
- **65/65** auxiliary checks pass: exact native objects, referenced laws/modifiers/known helpers, bilingual key validity, native JE GUI inheritance, bound-button references and exact reproduction from captured sources.
- Final catalogue: **493 effective IDs**, **zero legacy fields**, no ambiguous provider or parse finding. Direct typed reference/metadata audit: **zero findings**. **491** bound-button bindings and **527** static journal additions checked; no unresolved literal target remains in those checked paths.
- Eight accepted #27 witness files retain their exact hashes.
- Immutable #21 audit: raw **480/485**, because four old whole-file preservation assertions now cover migrated journals; scoped comparison reversing only #39 spans IN MEMORY returns the original **484/485**, with the pre-existing technology-events drift from #22. No #21 validator, contract or tracking was changed.
- Raw whitespace check remains nonzero: 87 diagnostics traced to original payload lines or exactly preserved indentation. Initial introduced blank-line artifacts were corrected; raw results and attribution are preserved.

### Limits and review
- No engine/GUI/DLC simulation or fresh-log acceptance was performed. Use the grouped **RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md**; save/reload, competing conclusions, timeout/forced-removal cleanup and all-involved execution remain runtime gates.
- Three entries without authored outcomes are individually retained rather than given invented conclusions. Six orphan/deadline presentation cases are documented as dormant.
- Five native IDs remain masked by retained older families: Australia, Canada, Extraordinary Commission, Paris Commune and Social Revolution. Full new DLC-chain adaptation needs #24 content review; the restored State and Revolution definition does not recable the old communism.2 choices. This compatibility pass is not a claim of complete new-DLC feature integration.
- Preserved the frozen #25 integration proposal, accepted #27 content, #21 exclusion, #17 law work and #38 deferral. A concurrent Indonesia map-file edit was recorded and left intact. HEAD/index unchanged; no Git or vanilla write.

Local evidence, **not committed/pushed**:
`docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE39_JOURNAL_CATALOGUE_2026_11_09/MIGRATION_R4/`
See `REPORT.md`, `RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md`, `MANIFEST.json`, `ENTRY_ACCOUNTING.json/.csv`, `INSTALLATION.json`, `LIVE_VALIDATION.json`, `AUXILIARY_FINAL_VALIDATION.json`, `DEPENDENCIES_FINAL.json`, `INVENTORY_FINAL.json` and protection/non-regression evidence.

The checked original checklist items below refer to inventory/mapping/migration/preservation. Unchecked runtime/full-content items are not waived.


<details>
<summary>Initial ownership and read-only inventory — retained history</summary>

## Current ownership — Hawk, 2026-11-09

**Project status: In progress.** Selected from the live Backlog at the maintainer's request after delivering #22 to In review.

First bounded pass completed: built a reproducible inventory of every effective journal ID/provider, legacy fields, outcome metadata, masks, duplicates and DLC-dependent entries. This pass is read-only for gameplay files and preserves #25's immediate integration preparation. No bulk rewrite starts in parallel with that preparation.

Subsequent migrations must use per-entry mappings and bounded batches, preserving accepted #27 paths. No new runtime acceptance is claimed by ownership. #21 remains excluded; #38's comprehensive American redesign and concurrent map/law/economy work are outside this task.

### Initial inventory delivered — 2026-11-09

**In progress; inventory-only phase complete, no gameplay migration or engine acceptance.**

- 490 effective journal IDs in 201 effective files, including 162 same-path native masks and one explicit replacement directive. No ambiguous providers or parse errors in this inventory.
- 400 entries across 166 files still contain 1,381 direct legacy conclusion fields. These are structural migration findings, not 400 reproduced in-game failures.
- 87 entries have outcomes without the inspected minimum-metadata defects; 3 have no outcome and are explicitly held for permanent/disabled-intent review.
- 526 static add-journal consumers inventoried. Two literal targets lack a definition: native button -> `je_five_year_plan` (the mod retains `je_5_year_plan`) and a local Meiji event -> `je_meiji_imperial_marriage`. One `$JE$` parameter is not misreported as a missing literal ID.
- Eight masked native IDs and sixteen missing title-key candidates in both FR/EN are listed individually. No automatic restoration, alias, reactivation or invented conclusion was applied.
- Six classification control cases passed; all 2,484 captured gameplay/data sources and the journal-provider hashes remained unchanged. HEAD/index unchanged. No Git or vanilla write.

Read-only reproducible tool: `tools/compatibility/issue39_journal_catalogue.py`.

Local evidence (not committed/pushed): `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE39_JOURNAL_CATALOGUE_2026_11_09/`, including `REPORT.md`, `NEXT_ACTION.md`, `INVENTORY.json`, `CATALOGUE.csv`, `ADD_JOURNAL_CONSUMERS.json`, `SOURCE_PROTECTION.json` and `VALIDATION.json`.

**Remaining:** per-entry semantic/dependency review, authored permanent/disabled exceptions, bounded migrations, localization resolution, DLC checks and human runtime acceptance. The original exhaustive acceptance checklist remains unchecked. Preserve #25 integration preparation before bulk gameplay edits, #27 accepted witnesses, #21 exclusion and #38 deferral.

---


</details>

---

## Objective

Audit **the complete effective journal-entry catalogue** for Victoria 3 1.15 and migrate every confirmed incompatibility, including entries that still fail to display completion or failure criteria.

The maintainer reports that additional journals remain broken after the bounded #27 batches were accepted. #27 is closed for those delivered lots; it was **not** an exhaustive migration. #24 is the broad map/journal/DLC workstream, but no separate exhaustive journal mission was found in the issue search on 2026-11-09.

**Parent workstream: #24. Release dependency: #25. Coordination: #19.**
**Priority: P1 overall; escalate entries active at the 1776 start or blocking a chain to P0.**
**Requested Project status: Backlog. Work order: mission #25 and its branch-integration preparation remain the maintainer's immediate priority.** Creating this issue does not start a bulk rewrite in parallel with #25.

## Scope

- Enumerate all journal definitions effectively loaded from the mod, same-path overrides, replacement directives and inherited native providers, with file/ID resolution.
- Cover the 1776-specific entries, inherited later-game entries, objectives/tutorials and DLC-dependent chains, including communist content and their consumers.
- Inspect activation, inactive visibility, progress bars, completion, failure, invalidation, deadlines, effects, continuations, buttons and required scripted dependencies.
- Investigate missing player-visible criteria as an actual journal/outcome contract issue; adding explanatory prose alone does not repair a rejected trigger.
- Distinguish intended permanent/inactive/hidden entries from genuinely broken conclusions. Document deliberate exceptions per entry rather than manufacturing success/failure conditions.

## Implementation checklist

- [x] Produce a complete, reproducible inventory of effective IDs and providers; record duplicates, shadowed definitions, native masks and intentionally disabled/permanent entries.
- [ ] Review every entry against the canonical local 1.15 journal contract and its actual scripted consumers; classify migrated, compatible, broken, intentionally disabled, permanent, or awaiting engine verification.
- [x] For each confirmed legacy conclusion, prepare a per-entry mapping to current outcomes preserving predicates, country/state/journal scopes, trigger ordering, simultaneous-condition priority, duration, progress and effects.
- [x] Migrate in bounded batches; preserve success/failure/timeout/invalidation cleanup, rewards, claims, variables, inheritance/transfer behavior and delayed follow-up events. No blanket regex migration.
- [ ] Verify displayed headers, criteria and effect lists; resolve missing IDs/scopes/dependencies that prevent those outcomes from loading.
- [ ] Check French/English localization, dynamic references and raw-key failures. Keep technical explanations internally; perform the immersive text pass after human functional acceptance as required by the repository guide.
- [x] Reuse and preserve accepted #27 paths as regression witnesses; do not reopen their accepted scope without a new, identified regression.
- [ ] Add representative engine tests for each migrated family: success, failure, deadline, invalidation, competing outcomes, continuation and active/concluded save/reload. Record unavailable scenarios explicitly.
- [ ] Compare new/rotated logs against an identified vanilla/reference configuration; separate prior debt, native-provider failures and new defects.
- [ ] Deliver the final inventory with every entry accounted for, remaining exceptions and human runtime acceptance; link the exact revision/candidate tested under #25.

## Preservation boundaries

The canonical vanilla installation is read-only. Preserve concurrent map/law/economy work and the original 1776 scenario. Do not reactivate the deferred Spanish chains, removed forced Polish partitions or other intentionally disabled historical content merely to remove a warning. Missing or optional DLC must not become an accidental mandatory dependency.

This is compatibility work, not the deferred comprehensive American Revolution redesign in #38.

## Acceptance

Every effective journal ID is accounted for. All confirmed broken outcome contracts in scope are fixed or explicitly blocked with a concrete dependency; no additional affected entry silently lacks its intended success/failure criteria. Authored mechanics and cleanup are preserved, relevant engine paths are accepted by the maintainer, and unresolved branches are visible to #25. A clean static scan alone does not certify all journals in game.
